name: SRY-box transcription factor 10
pathways: transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SOX10 encodes transcription factor SOX-10. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Waardenburg syndrome type 4C (autosomal dominant); PCWH syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

function.text: SOX10 encodes transcription factor SOX-10. Based in part on similarity, it is a transcription factor that plays a central role in developing and mature glia. It specifically activates expression of myelin genes, during oligodendrocyte (OL) maturation, such as DUSP15 and MYRF, thereby playing a central role in oligodendrocyte maturation and CNS myelination.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Waardenburg syndrome type 4C (autosomal dominant); PCWH syndrome (autosomal dominant).
